newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia intervenes in private financial firm.
newsitem.headline: Colombia intervenes in private financial firm.

text.p: The Colombian government seized the assets of a private financial firm on Friday in what the Finance Ministry described as a bid to protect the interests of its creditors and investors.

A ministry communique said the takeover of the commercial financing company called La Fortaleza was prompted by the failure of its shareholders to comply with commitments made with Colombia's Securities Superintendency.

It did not elaborate, except to say that the company had declined or been unable to comply fully with the terms of a restructuring agreement it signed with the Superintendency in January of this year.
Spokesmen for La Fortaleza could not be reached for immediate comment.
